description: This Java interface defines a ProtocolAdapter with methods for converting between Signal objects and Adaptable representations, and handling various command, event, and response types within the Eclipse Ditto protocol. It also includes static utility methods for channel determination.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapter
classes.description: Defines methods for converting signals to and from an adaptable format for protocol transmission, handling various specific command and event types, channel determination, and header translation management.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable to a Signal object (Command, Event, or Response).

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a Signal to an Adaptable representation.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a Signal to an Adaptable with a specified channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a CommandResponse to an Adaptable, assuming TWIN channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a CommandResponse to an Adaptable with specified channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingCommandResponse to an Adaptable.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingCommandResponse to an Adaptable with specified channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a MessageCommand to an Adaptable.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a MessageCommandResponse to an Adaptable.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a Command to an Adaptable.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a Command to an Adaptable with specified channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingModifyCommand to an Adaptable.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingModifyCommand to an Adaptable with specified channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingModifyCommandResponse to an Adaptable.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingQueryCommand to an Adaptable.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingQueryCommand to an Adaptable with specified channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingQueryCommandResponse to an Adaptable.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingQueryCommandResponse to an Adaptable with specified channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingErrorResponse to an Adaptable with specified channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Event to an Adaptable.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a ThingEvent to an Adaptable.

methods.name: headerTranslator
methods.description: Returns the HeaderTranslator responsible for this ProtocolAdapter.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Utility method to check if a Signal belongs to the live channel based on headers.

methods.name: determineChannel
methods.description: Static method to determine the channel (LIVE, TWIN, NONE) of a Signal based on headers and type.

methods.name: determineDefaultChannel
methods.description: Static method to determine default channel based on the Signal's type.
